points: Cua reads your Claude Code sign-in from the Keychain item “Claude Code-credentials” (macOS asks you to allow it), or the file ~/.claude/.credentials.json.
It keeps the access token in Cua's own item in the Keychain, never your refresh token, and doesn't change Claude Code's sign-in. You stay signed in to Claude Code.
Your Spaces get that access token so Claude Code can run there. Only Claude Code uses it.
When it runs out, Cua reads the newer one from Claude Code. Sign out here to remove the copy.
